mixing_scope:
Review contiguous bands and frozen-coefficient mixing estimates.

These are diagnostics of the existing mixing-only comparator, not a
calibration of semiconvection. The diffusion coefficients vary with the
composition gradient during evolution. Microscopic diffusion is additional.
mixing_timescale_assumptions: Planar L^2/D_eff is a crossing scale, not an eigenmode decay time. The spherical estimate assumes two well-mixed adjacent reservoirs, negligible barrier storage, frozen D and no other transport. Neither is the coupled stellar evolution timescale.

threeZ_physics.scope: Inventory and structure at the 3Z control's conductive separation and surge.
interpretation: Band formation precedes the nuclear-fraction maximum.
The central H decline is much larger than total H consumption; redistribution and changing convective membership matter.
Lnuc/L above one is net nuclear input in excess of surface output, not proof that total luminosity is decreasing.
No channel-resolved nuclear luminosities or full energy-storage integral are inferred here.
limitations: Evolution ends at150Gyr; not proof of1Tyr burning or failure.

threeZ_stability_reconstruction.scope: Uses saved total Z and birth metal ratios in the current EOS; no replacement for channel-resolved abundances.
